newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Pique - electrical tariffs to fall on Jan 1. [CORRECTED 11:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Spain's Pique - electrical tariffs to fall on Jan 1. [CORRECTED 11:30 GMT]

text.p: Spain's Minister of Industry and Energy Josep Pique confirmed on Thursday that electrical rates would decline on January 1, 1997.
Pique said bills would decline some one percent (corrects from five percent) for homes and between five and six percent for small- and medium-sized businesses.
Pique also said the decline would only be the first of a progressive fall in tariffs.

"Our idea is that with the introduction of reforms in the (electric) sector, there is not just going to be a fall in 1997, but we believe that progressive declines will take place in the future and that, practically forever, electricity, if it rises, will rise beneath the index of consumer prices," he said.
